description: This file contains unit tests for portability functions and threading utilities within the WPEFramework project, utilizing Google Test framework. It tests string case conversions, byte order functions, thread behavior, and error handling.

classes.name: ThreadClass
classes.description: A custom thread class derived from Core::Thread that runs a simple worker loop to test thread behavior.

methods.name: Worker
methods.description: Overrides Core::Thread::Worker to perform a simple thread operation that checks thread IDs and sets a flag.
